HRA corpus · 4 staff · 80 sessions

Repeat work

Four people at Halden & Reyes asked their assistants for the same things for six months. These are the jobs that repeat, the outputs they kept getting back, and the tool each one should become.

2 Mar – 18 Sep 2026

Evidence is quoted from chat-histories/json. Screenshots are real assistant and user turns, cut to fit; open one to read the whole turn. Repeat counts come from matching output shapes across every assistant turn.
